notes.title: Demo Update 0.4!
notes.notes:
[p]This update adds new control and accessibility options, thanks to valuable feedback from the community!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503813/8221e5c1a3da11dc9448691ba3a2aa5a5422a643.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New [b]TOGGLE[/b] setting, allowing players to lock buttons down with a quick tap.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]LAYOUT[/b] setting, allowing players to rearrange button placement.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]ICON[/b] styles.[/p][/*][*][p]Support for [b]macOS[/b]![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Adjustments:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Default button layout has been updated to better reflect button positions.[/p][/*][*][p]Time Attack button now loads level instantly.[/p][/*][*][p]Training Twist level renamed to "Trainyard Twist".[/p][/*][*][p]Improved art assets throughout.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor font adjustments.[/p][/*][/list][p]
Meanwhile, work is continuing steadily towards the full release! Hope to share more soon![/p][p][/p][p][/p]
